summary: Held the entire 26-frame window. Price never went negative from entry after frame 0 -- it repeatedly made new highs (peaking near +182pts around t=15m) and every pullback stayed a partial giveback of an already-large favorable leg (never round-tripped to flat), with fires flipping between against/with each cycle but no sustained multi-frame against-only breakdown. This was a genuinely working long, not a wrong-direction entry; the multi-TF momentum (1m/5m/15m/1h) stayed net positive throughout. Next time I'd watch for a giveback approaching 100% combined with against-fires stacking 3+ in a row AND price actually crossing back toward/through zero -- that combination never occurred here, which is why I never saw a bail signal.
